_notes.mode: off (default) | shadow (measure, never select) | assist (usable only after calibration on YOUR labeled data)
_notes.calibration: null until fitted; object {id, threshold, fitted_on, checkpoint_sha256} after L03 calibration
_notes.models: local approved paths only; sha256 verified before load; never download to satisfy a request
_notes.daemon: resident TCP daemon (layad), required for any assist mode; hooks fail-degraded to deterministic tiers when it is down
_notes.compact_gate: Layer 7 trigger bands; eval_floor gates all laya calls, force_at forces action even on abstain
